newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields end mixed, long end falls.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields end mixed, long end falls.

text.p: Swedish bond yields ended mixed on Thursday with the long end falling on the back of a much lower than expected U.S. Philly Fed index.

The short end edged higher as market players started fearing earlier than expected rate hikes after the Swedish April CPI came in higher than expected, showing a 0.5 percent rise from March compared to an expected 0.2 percent.

The crown firmed marginally in quiet trade. * Six-month T-bill rate rises two basis points to 4.19 pct. * Ten-year bond yield falls three basis points to 6.91 pct. * Crown firms to 4.4640 to mark vs 4.4700 on late Wednesday.
